title: ChatDmPeersResult
description: chat.dm-peers-result@1: which of the candidate people share a conversation with one person on OpenVibe.Chat (POST /internal/chat/dm/peers, chat.dm.peers.read). It answers with subjects only; a candidate with no shared conversation is simply absent. Used by OpenVibe.Network's presence privacy rule.

subject.description: The person whose conversations were read.

peers.description: The candidates that share at least one conversation with them, as subjects.
